title: Rethink the Evaluation for Attack Strength of Backdoor Attacks in Natural Language Processing
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical security aspects of backdoor attacks in NLP models. While it uses datasets that may touch upon ethical topics (e.g., HateSpeech) or use stylistic triggers related to religion (e.g., 'Bible' style), its purpose is to demonstrate a security vulnerability and a defense mechanism, not to evaluate or benchmark any component of faith, morals, or ethics.
